content: <thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 114.06808 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass within a few ppm is C₆H₉O₂ (calc. 113.0603 Da). The observed M+1 peak at m/z 115.0715 with ~6.7 % intensity matches the expected 13C isotopic contribution for six carbons, confirming the formula. Therefore the molecular formula is C6H9O2.
